name: 2 · Invoice email → extract with AI → validate → Sheets or review queue

parameters.content:
## Invoice email → spreadsheet
Watches Gmail for PDF invoices (EN / IT / AL).

1. Reads the PDF text
2. Claude extracts supplier, number, dates, net, VAT, total and lines as strict JSON
3. Code checks the maths: net + VAT = total, lines = net, dates parse, fields present
4. Clean invoices go straight to the Invoices sheet
5. Anything that doesn't add up goes to a Review queue and pings #accounts

filters.q: has:attachment filename:pdf (invoice OR fattura OR fature)
